associations.description: A vivid sunshine-yellow chair, as soft and padded as a beanbag, raised on visible wooden legs. An adult sinks into the cushions, smiling and visibly relaxing. A warm, playful room with a small music player in the background: everything feels easy.
associations.alt: An adult relaxes deeply in a bright yellow, beanbag-shaped chair on four wooden legs, with a small radio and a musical note nearby.
